283719323.description: This lot features a variety of tumbled and raw stones, crystals, and minerals including quartz, amethyst, and other semi-precious stones. Included is a decorative crescent moon ornament wire-wrapped with purple and green stones, glass beads, and charms. A notable piece is a yellow and brown mineral specimen with a rough, natural exterior. All items are in good display condition with no visible damage, and the collection includes a small Scorpio Zodiac Collection box.

283684754.description: This is a collection of mineral specimens including Apophyllite and Stilbite on a matrix, as well as various formations of quartz crystals. The minerals display diverse crystal structures and colors, with some clusters showing green and white hues. Ideal for collectors, educators, or display purposes. The largest measures about 4" x 4" x 6".

283165929.description: This collection features four natural mineral and stone pieces, including an amethyst crystal cluster with druzy points on matrix, a natural smoky quartz crystal point/cluster, a rough smoky quartz specimen, and a carved green soapstone figure titled "Where the Forest Go" #9508, signed by artist John Craig Loveing Bear. The carved figure depicts an abstract animal form with mottled green and black veining characteristic of soapstone, featuring a polished finish mounted on a rectangular base with visible tool marks. All pieces display natural mineral characteristics and minor surface wear consistent with age and handling. This vintage collection offers a nice variety for the mineral and art collector.
